title: Prompt Footprint Composer: Exportable Cost Attribution & Pricing Micro-patterns
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Design a composable UI for exploring and exporting per-prompt cost footprints. The Composer surfaces token-level attribution grouped by prompt slice, call type (generation vs embedding), and model variant, and provides export templates for finance and SRE teams. Focus is on flexible breakdowns, clear provenance, and patterns for pricing hints (e.g., recommended batch/quantization settings).
acceptance_criteria: Composer shows per-call and aggregated per-day cost rows with token and compute breakdowns
Users can pivot by prompt slice, model, and route and see attribution percentages
Exportable CSV/JSON template generation with selectable columns and saved presets
Prototype validated in 3 usability sessions with PMs and finance and >=80% task success
Design handoff includes annotated components and edge-case states (empty data, rate-limited, partial attribution)
design_notes: Primary unit: prompt call (request + response) with derived fields: input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, compute_score
Aggregation windows: 1h / 24h / 7d; allow custom range; default to 24h for quick scans
Attribution rules: prefer prefix/KV cache hits first, then model variant fallback; note heuristics in tooltip
Pricing hint strip: inline suggestions mapping token buckets to recommended batch size / quant profile
Performance: table must stream updates as new usage arrives; include skeleton states and progressive disclosure for heavy rows
review_feedback: 2025-02-18 - PM (Jia Chen): Prefer separate panes for export presets vs ad-hoc column selection; risk of clutter if both inline
2025-02-20 - Eng (Rafael Ortiz): Backend will expose cache-hit flags but not per-token trace; suggest adding estimated attribution margin
2025-02-24 - Finance (Nora Patel): Add currency conversions and per-unit price column; export should support monthly amortized rows
2025-02-28 - UX Research (Samira Khan): Users want a saved 'scenario' concept to compare pricing patterns between quantization settings
decisions: Ship initial Composer with CSV/JSON export only; defer ledger-native integration to next cycle
Show both absolute cost and cost per-1000 tokens to accommodate finance and engineer views
Expose a compact pricing-hint card per prompt slice with an action to create a pricing rule in PM console
